findings.title: Remote syslog destination not detected
findings.evidence: No logging host/IP command was found.
findings.recommendation: Consider sending logs to a protected central syslog/SIEM service; verify reachability and access controls.

findings.title: AAA new-model not detected
findings.recommendation: Assess centralized AAA (for example TACACS+ or RADIUS) for managed environments; local-only designs may be intentional.

findings.title: Login failure throttling not detected
findings.evidence: No login block-for command was found.
findings.recommendation: Where supported, configure login failure blocking based on operational policy.

findings.title: Log timestamps not explicitly configured
findings.evidence: No service timestamps log datetime command was found.
findings.recommendation: Enable useful timestamps for event correlation where supported.
findings.remediation_example: service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone

findings.title: NTP server not detected
findings.evidence: No ntp server command was found.
findings.recommendation: Configure approved time sources so logs can be correlated across devices.

findings.title: Routed interface has no interface ACL detected
findings.evidence: FastEthernet0/1 has an IP address but no ip access-group command was detected in the interface block.
findings.recommendation: Check the intended trust boundary and firewall/routing policy; an interface ACL is not required on every interface.

findings.title: Login or MOTD banner not detected
findings.evidence: No login, motd, or exec banner was found.
findings.recommendation: Use an organization-approved access warning banner where policy or law requires it.

findings.title: Source-routing protection not explicit
findings.evidence: no ip source-route was not found.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the platform default and explicitly disable source routing if supported by policy.

limitations: Offline static analysis only; no device connection was made.
The tool does not automatically apply remediation commands.
A missing command is not proof of a vulnerability; defaults vary by platform and software version.
Some checks are informational and require validation against topology, device model, IOS version and approved policy.
Risk score is a project heuristic, not a formal CVSS score or compliance certification.
